name: Fast Parse: the Morph playbook on document-to-structure
one_line: One specialized 2B-8B document-to-structure model (page image in; markdown + schema JSON out) served on a purpose-built vLLM path with visual-token budgeting, OCR-draft copy-speculation and constrained JSON decoding, priced per page — the Morph playbook applied to the one task where the repos hold a measured model-side result (Qwen2.5-VL-7B 0.925 vs GPT-4o 0.880 on DocVQA at 2.7x throughput).

numeric_claims.claim: Kill-gate and target thresholds (>=3x batch, >=2x latency, 40%/70% copy fraction, 1.5x, 30%/50% decode share, +1 pt, $5/$1 per 1K COGS, 2 of 3 pilots, 2x/5x frontier gap) and GPU-hour/day estimates in the Unproven table
numeric_claims.source: Pre-registered thresholds and effort estimates chosen by this brief (Sections 4, 6, 10); not measurements

unproven.claim: Document-to-structure output is mostly a verbatim copy of text present in the page (the property the copy speculator needs)
unproven.experiment: Parse 1,000 olmOCR-Bench/DocVQA pages with Qwen3-VL-8B; measure the share of output tokens that appear verbatim in the PDF text layer or a CPU OCR pass; kill gate < 40%, proceed >= 70%

unproven.claim: Copy-speculation (OCR/PDF-text draft via n-gram prompt lookup plus trained draft head) yields >= 2x single-stream decode speedup on full-page parse
unproven.experiment: Same pages on the same vLLM build with and without the copy draft; record acceptance length and seconds per page; kill < 1.5x

unproven.claim: Full-page parse is decode-dominated single-stream (so speculation matters) rather than prefill-bound
unproven.experiment: Time prefill and decode separately at 1024 px for 50/200/500-token outputs on Qwen3-VL-8B; the ledger's ~22 ms/step is a text-model reference only

unproven.claim: A LoRA-SFT Qwen3-VL-8B/4B on synthetic parse+extract pairs beats its base and reaches >= 85.2 on olmOCR-Bench (neither ledger contains any training result)
unproven.experiment: Generate ~50k synthetic pairs via the olmOCR recipe (~$0.12/page => ~$6k); LoRA SFT on one H100/H200; evaluate on olmOCR-Bench, DocVQA and a held-out extraction set; kill < base or < 82.4

unproven.claim: A trusted schema-extraction evaluation exists (the research files list parse benchmarks, not a field-extraction one)
unproven.experiment: Assemble from public key-information-extraction sets plus synthetic schemas; publish with the rerunnable harness

unproven.claim: Content-aware visual-token pruning beats naive resize at a matched token budget on Qwen3-VL (blocked on Qwen2.5-VL by mRoPE grid coupling)
unproven.experiment: Re-implement masked-token position handling on Qwen3-VL; sweep 0.5/0.25 fractions vs resize on DocVQA; drop after 2 weeks if no gain at 0.5

unproven.claim: Pages per GPU-second and $/1k pages hold under concurrency (the measured 30.2 img/s is short-answer, single-config)
unproven.experiment: Adapt the voice-inference loadgen/metrics harness to image prompts; sweep N = 8..256 concurrent pages on A100 and H100; report p95 s/page and pages/GPU-h; kill < 2x vs vanilla vLLM at equal accuracy

unproven.claim: Buyers value per-page latency in agent loops, not only batch $/page
unproven.experiment: Three design-partner pilots with logged seconds/page and accepted/rejected pages; kill if 0 of 3 use the interactive lane

unproven.claim: Per-page COGS for full-page parse (hundreds of output tokens) lands under $1 per 1,000 pages at real GPU rates
unproven.experiment: Measure pages/GPU-hour for parse (not field QA) on A100 and H100 and multiply by the rate card in 05-research-gpu-pricing.md; kill if COGS > $5/1K
unproven.cost_estimate: folded into the concurrency sweep (~10 GPU-hours)

founder_decisions.options: Pursue; treat as a wedge into a broader Morph-style catalog; or skip
founder_decisions.why_not_ours_to_make: The founder's rule forbids market-size judgments; the research files contain per-page price lists (Azure/Google/Textract $1.50-$50 per 1K, Reducto $0.01/page, Unstructured $0.015/page) but no volume disclosures for document APIs, so the informing evidence is the founder's own read plus week-1 pilot demand

founder_decisions.decision: Whether incumbents' adjacency matters (Reducto r-1 at $0.01/page, Mistral OCR 4 at $4/1K, open olmOCR-2/dots.mocr, hosted Qwen3-VL at $0.20/M, and Morph's ability to add a document model)
founder_decisions.options: Compete on latency plus per-page price with a public benchmark; pick another task from the selection table (compaction, voice, routing); or combine with another candidate direction
founder_decisions.why_not_ours_to_make: The brief states competitor facts neutrally; the founder's rule reserves the 'already exists' judgment; the week-1 baseline table is the evidence that would inform it

founder_decisions.options: Parse (public benchmarks olmOCR-Bench/OmniDocBench, likely higher copy fraction, lower price points $4-$10/1K) vs extract (price points $20-$50/1K, needs a new eval)
founder_decisions.why_not_ours_to_make: Depends on the measured copy fraction and per-SKU accuracy from weeks 1 and 4, and on which buyers the founder can reach

founder_decisions.decision: Hosted vs BYOC vs open weights
founder_decisions.options: Hosted per-page API (gateway exists); BYOC container (compose file exists); release weights like olmOCR/dots (distribution vs moat); Mistral-style enterprise self-host
founder_decisions.why_not_ours_to_make: Trades moat for distribution; Morph does not release weights while olmOCR/dots do; pilot procurement requirements are the informing evidence

founder_decisions.options: Qwen3-VL-8B (DocVQA 96.1) vs 4B (95.3) vs 2B (93.3) vs dots.mocr 3B (olmOCR-Bench 83.9) vs olmOCR-2-7B (82.4); train-from-scratch is out of 6-week scope
founder_decisions.why_not_ours_to_make: Accuracy-vs-throughput per size is unmeasured until the week-4 fine-tune and week-5 sweep; the tradeoff between latency and accuracy is a product-positioning call

founder_decisions.decision: GPU class for the benchmark and for production
founder_decisions.why_not_ours_to_make: No ledger data exists beyond A100/L40S; the week-5 two-class sweep informs it; capital and vendor relationships are the founder's

founder_decisions.options: Prompt-lookup n-gram draft only (no training; exists off-the-shelf, e.g. Baseten NGram) vs a trained task-specific draft head (Morph reports 3.07x vs 1.93x for task-trained vs generic drafts)
founder_decisions.why_not_ours_to_make: Week-2 acceptance-length measurements decide the payoff; the trained head is the moat candidate but costs training effort the founder must fund

founder_decisions.decision: Whether to publish the benchmark harness and numbers openly
founder_decisions.options: Open harness and public benchmark page (Wafer's approach) vs closed marketing pages (Morph's pages returned HTTP 429 in research)
founder_decisions.why_not_ours_to_make: Trades credibility with skeptical buyers against giving competitors a replication kit; pilot conversion is the evidence

founder_decisions.options: Per page (two SKUs), per credit (LlamaParse/Extend style), or per token (hosted-VLM style); batch discount depth; free tier size (10,000 pages matching Unstructured is a comparable, not a recommendation)
founder_decisions.why_not_ours_to_make: Depends on measured COGS per SKU from week 5 and on the founder's go-to-market posture
